neighbours.label: the character 出 ('out') when the tokenizer keeps it as its own token (strong: Chinese 出题, 出海, 出清, traditional 出發, Japanese 出ます, 日の出), plus Korean 출 in any word at about a third of that; weak when 出 is merged into one token with a neighbour (simplified 出发, 出来, 提出, 出席, 出身, 演出) and silent for 'out/leave' meanings without the character (离开, 行く, exit)
neighbours.short: 出 as its own token (Korean 출 weaker)
